messages:
Miriam K.: quick FYI — while following the staging playbook I hit a 410 for the link to the realtime-client-config runbook (staging). kb-link-check flagged it in the nightly scan (job #kb-link-check:3). Can someone claim/patch?

Miriam K.: broken URL: https://kb.redwood.ai/runbooks/realtime-client-config -> returns 410; target exists at /runbooks/realtime-client-config-v2 but many playbooks still point at the old path.

Jon P.: I think I originally authored that runbook back in 2022, I can take this. Do we want a redirect in front of a swap or just update references across repos? :thinking_face:

Miriam K.: short term: redirect + quick PRs to replace links. long term: update all references and remove legacy path. Redirect buys time for QA.

docs-bot: Automated alert: nightly-link-scan reported 1 broken link in docs scope "playbooks/*". Issue created: https://issues.redwood.ai/KB-5234 :robot_face:

Liam: pinging docs-owners — heads up this will touch several repos (infra/playbooks, deploy-scripts). If Jon opens PR, can docs review and then platform review for perm redirect?

Jon P.: will open PR tonight. planning to: 1) add nginx redirect rule in kb-config (short TTL) 2) update all playbook mentions via a single sed in each repo 3) open a KB cleanup issue to delete the old page after 30 days.

Jon P.: sed I used earlier (adjust paths as needed):
```bash
# replace legacy runbook links with v2 path in repo (run locally in repo root)
grep -R "realtime-client-config" docs | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | xargs -I{} sed -i '' -E 's@/runbooks/realtime-client-config(@/runbooks/realtime-client-config-v2(@g' {}
```

Rachel: happy to review the docs PR + double-check the playbook references. Add me as reviewer on the PR. :thumbsup:

Jon P.: opened PR: https://git.redwood.ai/docs/kb-config/pull/789 — includes nginx redirect + link updates in infra-playbooks. Marked with labels: kb-redirect, hotfix, staging-check.

Miriam K.: nice — can you also add a short note in the PR description about the KB smoke test that should run after deploy (curl the legacy URL and expect 301 -> v2)?

Jon P.: added smoke test step to PR description and a CI job link: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/789-smoke-kb

docs-bot: CI status: kb-link-check passed on branch jon/p/789 (2 checks remaining: deploy-preview, smoke-test).

Liam: once smoke-test green, ops can flip the redirect TTL to permanent and we can start bulk deleting legacy refs.

Rachel: quick note — please add the historical author tag to the PR description (Jon, you wrote it originally) so we can keep the audit trail.

Jon P.: added author attribution + changelog entry. Will merge after smoke-test passes. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

Miriam K.: thanks — ping here when merged and when deploy preview is up so we can remove the temporary alerts in the playbook sprint board.

Jon P.: will do.
